get.summary: Build version of the running API.
The caller's identity, roles, tenant scope and satisfied policies.
The platform templates a tenant can adopt or copy, with the tenant's types that come from each.
The platform integration templates a tenant can copy (std.event, generic-ap-json), with the tenant's mappings copied from each.

post.summary: Renders a mapping version or an expression over a document's values view (or sample values) on the server, without delivering; returns the output, render and target-schema errors and the paths it reads. A few previews run at a time per tenant (429 beyond).

get.summary: Calls, tokens and estimated cost of the current tenant per day, stage or model (inclusive UTC dates; the last 30 days by default).
API keys of the current tenant; secrets are never returned.

post.summary: Creates a key for the current tenant. The full key is returned once; store it now.

delete.summary: Revokes a key. Idempotent; revoked keys stay listed for audit.

post.summary: Uploads one or more files (multipart/form-data, or a single base64 file as JSON) and queues them for processing. Send Idempotency-Key to make retries safe.

files.description: One to 20 files, at most 52428800 bytes each.

channelId.description: An ingestion channel of the tenant; default: the tenant's API-upload channel.

get.summary: Ingestions newest first, cursor-paginated.
One ingestion with its items and the documents split from them.
Inbox: documents newest first with status, type, supplier, flag, issue-date and text filters, plus field.<key>=value for the indexed fields of the document types (docs/11 §18); cursor-paginated.
The review payload: summary, the canonical model with field provenance, flags, costs and origin.
Rendered page image (PNG, 1-based page number) for the viewer; ETag is the content hash.
The file the document was ingested from. PDFs and images are served inline with their content type; anything else is an attachment of application/octet-stream.
The positioned text layer (words with boxes per page) for the highlight overlay.
Timeline: state transitions, stage outcomes and human actions, oldest first.

post.summary: Approves a document waiting for review (or validated and not yet routed), closes its review tasks and queues publishing.
Rejects a document with a reason, closes its review tasks and queues publishing of the rejection.
Sends a failed, rejected, validated or review-pending document back through the pipeline from a stage it has reached (Normalize, Classify, Extract or Validate; default Extract).

patch.summary: Applies reviewer corrections by canonical field path to a document that needs review, is validated or has failed; each keeps the previous value in the field's history and is recorded as a Correction.

post.summary: Gives a document in review a type (docs/11 §12.1): pinned to the tenant's published version of it (or the version named), with prefill none (the empty fields of the type at once, 200) or auto (extracted again for that type, 202). A setType correction records it.
Assigns a supplier of the document's tenant to a document in review (docs/11 §12.1); the Match stage keeps it from then on, and the document is checked again with it.

Creates a supplier from a document in review, with the checks of POST /suppliers, and assigns it to the document (docs/11 §14). A reviewer gives the name, VAT id, tax id, IBANs and currency; emailDomains, aliases, alwaysReview and attributes need a tenant admin (403).

Splits a document in review into several documents by page (docs/11 §12.7): the first part keeps the id, the others are new documents of the same attachment; each is classified again, or extracted for the type a part names. 202.

get.summary: The documents of the same attachment as this one, in page order (docs/11 §12.7): what a reviewer can join it with, and the parts a split or a join left, cancelled ones with the document they were joined into.

post.summary: Joins other parts of the same attachment into this document, pages in attachment order (docs/11 §12.7); the others are cancelled with a link to it, and the joined document is classified again. 202.

get.summary: The words of a page with their boxes in page units (docs/11 §12.3); with bbox=x0,y0,x1,y1 the words inside it, their text in reading order and its readings per kind (date, number, amount, ...) in the locale (the tenant's country by default).

post.summary: Reads the words inside a box of a page image with OCR (docs/11 §12.3), for a scan without a text layer there; 501 when no OCR provider is configured. A few reads run at a time per tenant (429 beyond).

The table tool (docs/11 §12.4): proposes columns for a box, or reads the rows of a mapping drawn on one page over the pages named, with the table report per page; write: true stores the rows as one correction and the report. One read has a time budget (422 TABLE_READ_TOO_SLOW past it), and a few run at a time per tenant (429 beyond).

get.summary: The stored table reports of the document's repeating groups (docs/11 §6.2 DocumentTableReport): the page strip after a table capture.
The review queue, urgent then high then normal priority, oldest first within each (Open and InProgress by default; filter by status or assignedTo=me), each with its document summary.

post.summary: Assigns the task to the caller and marks it InProgress; 409 when another reviewer holds it.
Returns the task to the queue. The assignee may release it; a tenant admin may release anyone's.

get.summary: Tenants of the platform, by slug, with status and text filters. Operators may list; only SuperAdmins change anything.

post.summary: Creates a tenant with its default API-upload and portal-upload channels.

get.summary: One tenant.

patch.summary: Changes name, legal name, VAT id, aliases or status of a tenant.

post.summary: Suspends a tenant: its users and API keys stop working until it is activated again.
Activates a suspended tenant.

get.summary: Suppliers of the current tenant, by name; q matches the folded name or the exact VAT id.

post.summary: Creates a supplier; the folded name used for matching is derived server-side.

get.summary: One supplier of the current tenant.

patch.summary: Changes a supplier's identifiers, aliases, domains or review setting.

delete.summary: Deletes a supplier no document, extractor profile or output binding references; otherwise 409.

get.summary: The supplier's twenty most recent documents.
Ingestion channels of the current tenant; credentials are never returned.

post.summary: Adds a mailbox, watched-folder, API-upload or portal-upload channel to the current tenant; the credential is write-only.

patch.summary: Renames, pauses/resumes or reconfigures a channel; secret rotates (value) or clears (empty string) the credential.

delete.summary: Deletes a channel that has never received anything and no output binding is scoped to, and its credential; otherwise 409.

get.summary: Members of the current tenant and their roles.

post.summary: Adds a user (by identity-provider subject) to the current tenant with a role.

patch.summary: Changes a member's role. The last TenantAdmin cannot be demoted.

delete.summary: Removes a member. The last TenantAdmin cannot be removed.

get.summary: Review policy, retention and feature switches of the current tenant, with its read-only identity.

put.summary: Replaces the review policy and retention of the current tenant, and its feature switches when features is given.

get.summary: The tenant's document types.

post.summary: Adopts or copies a platform template ({from}), or creates a type of the tenant's own ({definition}) as draft version 1.

get.summary: One of the tenant's types with its versions.
The versions of a type, oldest first.

post.summary: Starts the next version of a copied or custom type as a draft, from the published version.

get.summary: One version with its definition; include=formSpec,jsonSchema,llmSchema,descriptors adds the compiled artifacts. The ETag is the draft revision.

put.summary: Replaces a draft's definition (If-Match: the revision read). The meta-schema is checked on save; everything else on validate and publish.

post.summary: Runs the publish-time checks on a version and returns the report, without publishing.
Publishes a draft when the publish-time checks pass (422 with the report otherwise); the previous version is deprecated.

get.summary: The tenant's output mappings and the platform templates, with their versions.

post.summary: Copies a platform template ({from: {template}}) or creates a mapping of the tenant's own; version 1 is a draft.

get.summary: One mapping (the tenant's, else the platform template of that key) with its versions.

patch.summary: Renames, describes, scopes to a type or archives one of the tenant's mappings.

post.summary: Starts the next version as a draft, from the published version (409 when a draft exists).

get.summary: One version with its expression and target schema; the ETag is the draft revision.

put.summary: Replaces a draft (If-Match: the revision read). The expression and target schema are checked on publish.

post.summary: Publishes a draft when its expression parses and its target schema is one (422 with the errors otherwise); the previous version is deprecated.

get.summary: The tenant's destinations; secrets are never returned.

post.summary: Adds an http, blob or pull destination; the config is checked per transport, the secret is write-only.

get.summary: One destination.

patch.summary: Renames, disables or reconfigures a destination.

delete.summary: Removes a destination no binding and no delivery refers to (409 otherwise: disable it instead), with its secrets.

put.summary: Sets or rotates the destination's secret; the replaced secret stays as the previous one until the next rotation.

get.summary: The tenant's output bindings.

post.summary: Binds events and a scope (type, supplier, channel, condition) to a mapping and a destination.

get.summary: One output binding.

patch.summary: Changes a binding; absent fields stay.

delete.summary: Removes a binding without deliveries (409 otherwise: disable it instead).

get.summary: The tenant's deliveries, newest first, filtered by document, destination and status.
One delivery with its attempts and the external id.
The payload snapshot the delivery sends.

post.summary: Sends a delivery again as a new delivery, from its snapshot or rendered again; a dead letter it replaces is cancelled.

get.summary: The entries of a pull destination's feed after the cursor (without one: from the oldest entry not acknowledged).

post.summary: Acknowledges feed entries, which marks their deliveries delivered.

get.summary: The tenant's lookup tables and the platform code lists.

post.summary: Adds an empty lookup table to the tenant.

get.summary: One lookup table with its entries (the tenant's, else the platform's of that key); the ETag is its revision.

patch.summary: Changes a table's description or case sensitivity.

delete.summary: Removes one of the tenant's lookup tables with its entries.

put.summary: Replaces every entry of one of the tenant's tables (If-Match: the revision read).

get.summary: Which provider configuration each stage of the current tenant uses and whether the platform key may stand in.

put.summary: Sets the default configuration, per-stage overrides and platform-key fallback; every id must be one of the tenant's own configurations.

get.summary: The tenant's own (BYOK) provider configurations, without credentials.

post.summary: Adds a BYOK provider: the key goes to the secret store, SQL keeps its reference, last four characters and fingerprint.
Disables a configuration; stages that resolve to it wait or fall back per the policy.
Re-enables a disabled or invalid configuration.

delete.summary: Deletes a configuration the policy does not reference, and its key from the secret store; usage rows keep its id for cost history.

get.summary: The platform's default provider configurations (per data residency), without credentials.

post.summary: Adds a platform provider configuration; the key goes to the secret store under platform scope.
Kill switch: no call goes to this platform configuration until it is enabled again.
Re-enables a platform configuration.

get.summary: Calls, tokens and estimated cost across tenants per tenant, model or day (inclusive UTC dates; the last 30 days by default).

destinationId.description: The pull destination a `deliveries:read` key is restricted to; null for all of the tenant's.

ApprovalBlock.description:
What keeps a document from being approved: `code` is `TYPE_REQUIRED` (the type is Unknown),
`NO_DEFINITION` (the type has no published definition the tenant can use) or `NO_DATA` (nothing was
captured: the document has no canonical data); `message` says it in English.

AssignSupplierRequest.description: `POST /documents/{id}:assign-supplier` (docs/11 §12.1): a supplier of the document's tenant.

ChannelResponse.description: bool ChannelResponse.HasSecret is all a client learns about the credential; the reference itself stays server-side.

CorrectionSource.description:
Where a corrected value came from (docs/11 §6.2 `Correction.SourceJson`). Every part is optional.
`method` names how the reviewer picked it (for example `word`, `region`, `ocr`); `page` is
1-based; `bBox` is in the text layer's 1000 × 1000 page units; `rawText` is the text as printed;
`words` lists the picked words as `[page, wordIndex]` pairs; `path` and `cell` locate a value
in a structured file (an XML element path, a spreadsheet cell such as `B7`).

CreateApiKeyRequest.description: Guid? CreateApiKeyRequest.DestinationId restricts a `deliveries:read` key to one pull destination (docs/11 §13.3).

CreateChannelRequest.description:
JsonElement? CreateChannelRequest.Config is the type-specific settings object (mailbox address, folder path), at most 16 KB.
string? CreateChannelRequest.Secret is write-only: the mailbox password or token goes to the secret store under a reference the
server generates; the response only ever says whether one exists.

CreateDestinationRequest.description: `POST /destinations`: a name, a transport (`http`, `blob`, `pull`), its config and, write-only, the secret.

CreateDocumentTypeRequest.description:
`POST /document-types` (docs/11 §18): DocumentTypeSource? CreateDocumentTypeRequest.From to adopt or copy a template (under string? CreateDocumentTypeRequest.Key,
or its legacy key or its id without `std.`), or JsonElement? CreateDocumentTypeRequest.Definition for a type of the tenant's own.

CreateLlmProviderRequest.description: string CreateLlmProviderRequest.ApiKey is write-only: it goes to the secret store and is never returned or persisted in SQL.

CreateOutputMappingRequest.description:
`POST /output-mappings`: OutputMappingSource? CreateOutputMappingRequest.From copies a platform template (under string? CreateOutputMappingRequest.Key, or the
template's key), or a mapping of the tenant's own from string? CreateOutputMappingRequest.Key, string? CreateOutputMappingRequest.Name and an optional first
draft (string? CreateOutputMappingRequest.Engine, string? CreateOutputMappingRequest.Expression, JsonElement? CreateOutputMappingRequest.TargetSchema). Either way version 1 is a draft.

attributes.description: The supplier's attributes: at most 50 keys, each a string (at most 400 characters), a number, a boolean or null.

CreatedApiKey.description: Returned once, on creation: string CreatedApiKey.Key is never retrievable again.

DeliveryAttemptDto.description: One attempt at a delivery: when, how long, the status code, the error class and the response excerpt (4 KB, secrets masked).

DeliveryDetail.description: A delivery with its attempts and the document's external id at its destination.

DeliverySummary.description: One delivery as the API shows it (docs/11 §13.6): what was rendered with what, for which binding and destination, and where it stands.

DestinationResponse.description:
A destination as the API shows it. The secret is write-only: bool DestinationResponse.HasSecret and DateTimeOffset? DestinationResponse.SecretSetAt
are all a client learns, bool DestinationResponse.HasPreviousSecret whether the one it replaced is still kept for the overlap.

DocumentDefinitionRef.description:
The type version a document is shown with (docs/11 §18 `DocumentDetail.definition`): its key, version and
catalogue row, the display name by locale and the compiled form spec the review form renders (docs/11 §5.5, artifact
3). Sent for definition-driven documents and for every document of a tenant with `configurableTypes` on.

oneOf.description: How the supplier was found (docs/11 §6.2): `Human` when a reviewer assigned it; null without one or before it was recorded.

joinedIntoDocumentId.description: The document a reviewer joined this one into (`:join`, docs/11 §12.7); set on a `Cancelled` part.

oneOf.description:
Why `:approve` would refuse the document now (docs/11 §11 "Approve is refused when a document has no definition
or no canonical data"), so the review screen can say so before the click; null when nothing stands in the way.

configurableTypes.description:
Whether the document's tenant has `configurableTypes` on (docs/11 §3 principle 6): the review screen offers the
review tools of P2 (the Map this document panel, set type, assign or create the supplier, split and join) only
then, so a tenant that is not on the feature reviews as before.

outputs.description:
Whether the document's tenant has `outputs` on (docs/11 §3 principle 6, P3): the review screen shows the
Deliveries tab (`GET /deliveries?documentId=`) only then, so a tenant that is not on the feature sees the
screen as before.

DocumentDetail.description:
The review screen's payload (docs/05 "canonical data + flags + provenance"): every summary column plus the
canonical model exactly as stored (`Canonical`: the Invoice / PurchaseOrder / DeliveryNote JSON, null until
extraction has run), so every `FieldValue` keeps its provenance and history verbatim. `PageImageUrls` are
API-relative, in page order (`/api/v1/documents/{id}/pages/{n}.png`). `TenantId` / `TenantName` name
the owning tenant like the summary's, so a platform-scope detail page can say whose document it is.
`CanonicalSchemaVersion` 2 marks a definition-driven tree (docs/11 §5.6); `TypeName` (English, else the first
locale), `TypeVersion` and `Definition` describe the type version it is shown with when the API resolved one.
`AppliedConfig` is what the pipeline resolved for the document (docs/11 §6.2, §18 `AppliedConfigJson`): the
type version and its key, the template, and after an LLM extraction the schema it was sent; null before Extract.

DocumentFlagDto.description:
One flag of a document. `Message` is English for API clients; `Params` holds the same facts as invariant
strings (field paths, ISO dates, amounts and ratios with a dot, `reason` naming the message variant) so a UI can
phrase the flag in its own language from `Code` (docs/02 §5 "Flag parameters"). Empty for a flag without
parameters, and for flags stored before parameters existed: show `Message` then.

DocumentIngestionRef.description: Where the document came from: the ingestion and the attachment it was split from.

DocumentPartDto.description:
One document of an attachment (`GET /documents/{id}/parts`, docs/11 §12.7): its pages within the attachment
(1-based, inclusive), status, type and number; a part cancelled by a join names the document it was joined into.

DocumentSummary.description:
One row of the inbox (docs/05 "Inbox"): the denormalised columns plus flag counts, never the canonical JSON.
`TenantId` / `TenantName` name the owning tenant, so a platform-scope list (the admin console's
cross-tenant documents list and global review queue) can show whose row it is. `ValidFrom`, `ValidUntil` and
`LineCount` are the denormalised roles of docs/11 §6.2 (a price list shows its validity and row count instead of a
total); `ReviewPriority` and `ReviewDueAt` are the open review task's priority and due time, null without one.
`Fields` holds the indexed field values the list request asked for with `fields=` (docs/11 §19, the inbox
columns of indexed custom fields), keyed by definition path, as `DocumentFieldIndex` stores them (identifiers and
strings normalised, numbers invariant, dates ISO); null when the request named none.

DocumentTableReportDto.description:
A stored table report (docs/11 §6.2 `DocumentTableReport`): the group, who wrote it, the Correction that wrote
the rows, the document version it describes, when, and the report.

DocumentTemplateSummary.description:
A platform template in the catalogue (`GET /document-templates`): its key and version, its name and
description, the legacy key existing tenants adopted it under (if any), the key adopting or copying it uses when
the request names none (`DefaultKey`) and the tenant's type keys that come from it (`AdoptedAs`).

DocumentTypeDetail.description:
A tenant's document type (docs/11 §6.1) with its versions, and the fields the inbox can filter by
(`IndexedFields`).

DocumentTypeKey.description: A document type key: a legacy type (Unknown, Invoice, CreditNote, PurchaseOrder, DeliveryNote, Statement, Reminder, Other) or a key of one of the tenant's types.

DocumentTypeSource.description: Where a new type comes from: a platform template, adopted (follows it) or copied (a fork).

DocumentTypeVersionDetail.description: One version with its definition and, on request (`include=formSpec,jsonSchema,llmSchema,descriptors`), its compiled artifacts.

DocumentTypeVersionSummary.description: One version of a tenant's type, without its JSON.

ExternalRefDto.description: The receiving system's id of the document at the delivery's destination (`responseMapping`).

FeedAckRequest.description:
`POST /feeds/{destinationId}:ack`: acknowledges every entry up to and including long? FeedAckRequest.UpTo, and/or the
listed IReadOnlyList<Guid>? FeedAckRequest.DeliveryIds. Acknowledging an entry twice is not an error.

FeedAckResponse.description: How many entries this call acknowledged, and whether entries up to `upTo` are left for another call.

FeedEntry.description:
One entry of a pull feed (docs/11 §13.3): its long FeedEntry.Sequence (the `after` cursor), the delivery, and
the payload, as JSON in JsonElement? FeedEntry.Payload or, for any other content type, base64 in string? FeedEntry.PayloadBase64.

FeedPage.description: A page of a feed: the entries after the cursor, long FeedPage.Next to pass as `after` next time, and whether more are waiting.

FieldCorrection.description:
One human correction (docs/05 "PATCH /documents/{id}/fields"). string FieldCorrection.Path is a canonical field path as
`Invoice.EnumerateAllFields` produces it (`invoiceNumber`, `lines[2].quantity`, `supplier`) or a
property inside such a field's value (`supplier.vatId`); JsonElement? FieldCorrection.Value is the new value in the JSON
shape of the field (a number for an amount with the document currency, a string for an identifier) or null to
clear it. `op` is the correction operation: `set` (the default); `move` (docs/11 §12.3 "match
fields", every document with data): the value of the field `from` names goes into string FieldCorrection.Path, converted
to that field's kind, with its place on the page, and `from` is left without a value; both fields keep their
previous state in their history, and the move is one Correction row (op `move`, the source path in its
`SourceJson.from`). For a definition-driven document (`canonicalSchemaVersion` 2) also `append` (a
row of a repeating group, with an optional object of row values, or a list entry) and `remove` (a row, a list
entry or a bag key). `setType`, `split` and `join` are review actions of their own
(`:set-type`, `:split`, `:join`), not corrections. `source` optionally says where on the page
or in the file the reviewer took the value from; it is stored with the field's provenance and on the Correction row.

IndexedFieldDto.description:
A field of a type that `DocumentFieldIndex` holds (docs/11 §6.2): its definition path, which is the key of the
document list's `?field.<path>=value` filter and of its `fields` columns, its kind and its label by locale.

IngestionJsonUpload.description: JSON alternative to multipart for a single file: integrations that cannot build multipart bodies.

ItemDisposition.description:
What stage 1 decided about an item. ItemDisposition.Candidate is the undecided state the channels store; every other
value is final. Exactly one ItemDisposition.Accepted item per tenant and SHA-256 may exist: the filtered unique index
IngestionItemOwnership enforces it in the database.

JoinDocumentsRequest.description: `POST /documents/{id}:join` (docs/11 §12.7): the other parts of the same attachment to join into this one.

LlmProviderResponse.description:
A provider configuration without its credential (docs/08 "Key handling"): the last four characters show which key it
is, and `keyFingerprint` (the first 16 hex digits of the key's SHA-256) tells whether a key a client holds
is the stored one without the key ever leaving the secret store.

LlmUsageBucket.description: Usage of one group (a day, a stage, a model or a tenant) in the requested window.

LookupEntryDto.description: One entry: from, to, valid from and to (inclusive, `yyyy-MM-dd`), labels by locale.

LookupTableDetail.description: A lookup table with its entries; the ETag is the revision.

LookupTableSummary.description: A lookup table without its entries: the tenant's (`Platform` false) or a platform code list.

MeResponse.description: Who am I: the identity, roles, resolved tenant scope and the policies this caller satisfies.

OutputBindingResponse.description: A binding as the API shows it: events, scope, the mapping (by key) and the destination.

OutputMappingCheckReport.description: Why a version cannot be published: the expression's or the target schema's error.

OutputMappingDetail.description: An output mapping of the tenant, or a platform template (`Origin` Platform, read-only), with its versions.

OutputMappingSource.description: Where a new mapping comes from: a platform template to copy.

OutputMappingVersionDetail.description: One version with its expression, target schema and what it reads.

OutputMappingVersionSummary.description: One version of an output mapping, without its expression.

OutputPreviewRequest.description:
`POST /output-mappings:preview` (docs/11 §13.1, §18): a mapping version (Guid? OutputPreviewRequest.MappingVersionId) or an
expression (string? OutputPreviewRequest.Expression, with string? OutputPreviewRequest.Engine and JsonElement? OutputPreviewRequest.TargetSchema), rendered over a
document's values view (Guid? OutputPreviewRequest.DocumentId) or over JsonElement? OutputPreviewRequest.SampleValues, without delivering.
string? OutputPreviewRequest.Event sets `meta.event` (default `document.approved`); bool? OutputPreviewRequest.IncludeValues returns
the values view rendered over, for the editor's source tree.

OutputPreviewResponse.description:
What the preview rendered: the output (null with `undefined` when the expression yields nothing), its size,
the render errors, the target-schema errors, the values-view paths and lookup tables the expression reads, how long
the render took and, on request, the values view.

OutputTemplateSummary.description: A platform integration template (`GET /output-templates`, docs/11 §13.9) and the tenant's mappings copied from it.

PageOfDeliverySummary.description: One page of a cursor-paginated list (docs/05 "cursor pagination"); string? Page<T>.NextCursor is null on the last page.

PageOfDocumentSummary.description: One page of a cursor-paginated list (docs/05 "cursor pagination"); string? Page<T>.NextCursor is null on the last page.

PageOfIngestionSummary.description: One page of a cursor-paginated list (docs/05 "cursor pagination"); string? Page<T>.NextCursor is null on the last page.

PageOfReviewTaskDto.description: One page of a cursor-paginated list (docs/05 "cursor pagination"); string? Page<T>.NextCursor is null on the last page.

PageOfSupplierResponse.description: One page of a cursor-paginated list (docs/05 "cursor pagination"); string? Page<T>.NextCursor is null on the last page.

PageOfTenantResponse.description: One page of a cursor-paginated list (docs/05 "cursor pagination"); string? Page<T>.NextCursor is null on the last page.

PageWordDto.description: A word of a page in page units (0 to 1000), with its index in the text layer's word list of that page (null for a word OCR just read).

PageWordsResponse.description:
`GET /documents/{id}/pages/{n}/words?bbox=` and `POST /documents/{id}/regions:read` (docs/11 §12.3): the
page's words in page units. `source` says where they come from: `pdfText` (the PDF's own text layer),
`ocr` (an OCR text layer, or the region OCR just ran) or `none` (the page has no text layer: draw a box
and read it with `regions:read`). With a box, `words` are the words whose centre lies inside it, `text`
is them joined in reading order, `bBox` their union and `candidates` the readings of `text` per kind
in `locale`; without one, every word of the page and no candidates. `provider` names the OCR that read a
region.

PatchChannelRequest.description: Every field optional; absent fields are left as they are. string? PatchChannelRequest.Secret set to a value rotates the credential, set to an empty string removes it.

PatchDestinationRequest.description:
Every field optional. A config replaces the stored one; string? PatchDestinationRequest.Status is Active or Disabled. A config that
would send the stored secret somewhere else (another host of a URL or of the token URL, another auth type or header
name) needs `secret` in the same request (400 under `secret` otherwise), which then replaces the stored
secret and drops the previous one; without such a change `secret` rotates the secret as
`PUT /destinations/{id}/secret` does.

PatchOutputBindingRequest.description:
Every field optional; absent fields are left as they are. A string set to empty clears an optional one
(`documentTypeKey`, `condition`, `exclusiveGroup`, `updateMappingKey`); `clearSupplier`,
`clearChannel` and `clearPinnedVersion` clear the others.

PatchOutputMappingRequest.description: Every field optional; an empty string? PatchOutputMappingRequest.SourceTypeKey clears it (any type). string? PatchOutputMappingRequest.Status is Active or Archived.

attributes.description: The supplier's attributes, replacing the stored ones (an empty object clears them).

PatchSupplierRequest.description: Every field optional; absent fields are left as they are. A string set to empty clears it; a list replaces the stored list.

PatchTenantRequest.description: Every field optional; absent fields are left as they are. string? PatchTenantRequest.VatId set to an empty string clears it.

PublishReportDto.description: The publish-time checks' report (docs/11 §5.7): what blocks, what to know, which fields changed.

PutLookupEntriesRequest.description: `PUT /lookup-tables/{key}/entries`: every entry of the table (replacing the stored ones), If-Match: the revision.

ReadRegionRequest.description:
`POST /documents/{id}/regions:read` (docs/11 §12.3): the box (page units) on page `page` to read with OCR,
for a scan whose text layer has no words there; `locale` reads the candidates (the tenant's country by default).

ReadTableRequest.description:
`POST /documents/{id}/regions:table` (docs/11 §12.4). Without `columns`: the dividers proposed from the box
drawn on `page` (word gaps and header words, each column named from the field labels its header matches), with
the rows they read on that page. With `columns`: the rows the mapping reads on `pages` (`1-*`,
`2-5,7`; just `page` by default), and the table report. `path` is the repeating group (the type's
line items by default), `rowAnchor` the field that starts a row (the group's anchor by default),
`repeatHeader` `auto` (default) or `none`, `continuation` `appendToPrevious` (default) or
`none`, `skipRows` and `stopAt` regular expressions over a line's text, `pageMargins` the band
of the other pages that is read (a box drawn only around the header row reads every page down to the bottom margin,
or the foot of the page). `repeatedLines` `skip` (default) leaves out lines printed at the same height with
the same text on at least half of the document's pages (running titles, page numbers, footers; a number stands for any
number) unless they read as a row, `keep` reads them. A column is a tier column only when it names
`tierMinQuantity` (the proposal reads it from a header such as `ab 10`); one without a field or a quantity
is left out, and its words count for nothing. `write: true` writes the
rows into the document as one correction (op `set` on `path`, the specification and report in its source)
and stores the report (docs/11 §6.2 `DocumentTableReport`).

ReadTableResponse.description:
What `regions:table` answers: the repeating group, whether the columns were proposed, the columns and header row
used (to draw the dividers), the row anchor, the report, the rows (the first 1,000; `rowsTruncated` when there
were more), with `write` the document as stored after the write, and the locale the values were read in
(`de-DE`: the request's, or the tenant country's).

RedeliverRequest.description:
`POST /deliveries/{id}:redeliver` (docs/11 §13.6): `snapshot` (the default) sends the stored payload
again; `rerender` renders the document again, with int? RedeliverRequest.MappingVersion of the binding's mapping or the
version the binding follows now.

RenderErrorDto.description: A render error as the API shows it: its kind (`syntax`, `runtime`, `required`, `timeLimit`, ...), the engine's code, the message and the position in the expression.

ReprocessDocumentRequest.description:
Which stage to rerun; the document is reset to the state before it (docs/03 "any stage can be re-run").
`configMode` (docs/11 §18): `pinned` (the default) reruns with the type version the document is pinned to;
`current` drops the pin, so the rerun takes the tenant's published version of the type now (for example a fork
with a custom field published after the document arrived).

ReviewTaskDto.description: A review-queue entry; `TenantId` / `TenantName` name the owning tenant (see DocumentSummary).

SaveOutputMappingDraftRequest.description: A draft's content (`PUT /output-mappings/{key}/versions/{v}`, If-Match: the revision).

SetDestinationSecretRequest.description: `PUT /destinations/{id}/secret`: the new secret; the one it replaces is kept as the previous secret for the overlap of a rotation (docs/11 §16).

SetDocumentTypeRequest.description:
`POST /documents/{id}:set-type` (docs/11 §12.1 step 3): the type key, optionally a published version of it
(the tenant's published version otherwise), and `prefill`: `none` (the default; the document gets the
empty tree of the type version, every field Missing, at once) or `auto` (the document goes back through the
Extract stage for that type, which fills what it can; 202).

SourceBox.description: An axis-aligned box in page units (0 to 1000 on both axes, origin top left), as the canonical JSON stores boxes.

SplitDocumentRequest.description: The parts of a split, in page order; together they cover every page of the document exactly once.

SplitPartRequest.description:
One part of `POST /documents/{id}:split` (docs/11 §12.7): its pages, 1-based within the document and
consecutive, and optionally the type a reviewer already knows it has (the part then skips classification).

SplitPartResult.description: A part a split produced: the first keeps the document's id, the others are new documents of the same attachment.

SupplierActivityItem.description: One recent document of a supplier, for the supplier activity view (docs/05 "Suppliers: ... activity").

SupplierFromReviewResponse.description: What `POST /documents/{id}:create-supplier` answers: the new supplier and the document it was assigned to.

attributes.description: The tenant's attributes of the supplier (docs/11 §6.4, `{"erpVendorId": "V-10042"}`), what output mappings read as `supplier.attributes`.

TableBandDto.description: A vertical band in page units (the header row).

TableCellDto.description: A value of a row: field, printed text, the value read (shape of a correction), its page and box.

TableColumnBoundsDto.description: The dividers of one column on one page.

TableColumnDto.description: A column of a table mapping in page units of the mapping page: its dividers, the row field it fills (none to leave it out), its printed header, and a tier column's minimum quantity.

TableGroupHeaderDto.description: Group headings (docs/11 §8.6): `target` is the row field a heading fills; `when` the column whose emptiness makes a line a heading (the first amount column by default).

TableMarginsDto.description: The part of every page the table uses (docs/11 §8.6 `pageMargins`), in page units: running headers above `top` and footers below `bottom` are left out.

TablePageOverrideDto.description: Dividers set by hand for one page (`pageOverrides`), one per column of the mapping.

TablePageReportDto.description:
One page of the table report (docs/11 §12.4, the page strip): rows that start on it, rejected lines (count, and the
first 50 with their text), skipped lines, headings and continuation lines, whether its header row was found, the
dividers used and where they came from (`mapping`, `header`, `previousHeader`, `override`), its
first three rows as printed, and the band of the page read (`top` to `bottom`, page units: below the header
row, within the page margins; absent in a report stored before it was recorded). `headings` are the texts of the
group headings read on the page (the first 20), so a running title or footer taken for one shows; `repeatedLines`
counts the lines left out as running titles, page numbers or footers and `repeatedTexts` lists their texts (the
first 20), `leftOutLines` the lines with words only in columns the mapping leaves out (absent in a report stored
before they were recorded).

TableRejectedLineDto.description: A line that did not become a row: its text, box, a reason code (`unreadable`, `noAnchor`, `continuationConflict`, `anchorOnly`), the message and the field.

TableReportDto.description: The table report (docs/11 §8.6, §12.4): totals, pages read, pages without rows, the page a stop line ended it on, and every page.

TableRowDto.description: A row the table read: the page it starts on, its box there, its values and tiers.

TableTierColumnsDto.description:
Tier price columns (docs/11 §8.6): a column without a field whose header matches `headerPattern` (group 1 the
minimum quantity; `ab\s+(\d+)` by default) or that names `tierMinQuantity` becomes entries of the row's
`target` list (`tiers`) with `quantityField` (`minQuantity`) and `priceField` (`price`).

TableTierDto.description: A tier price of a row: the minimum quantity and the price cell.

TenantFeaturesDto.description:
The per-tenant switches of docs/11 §3 (principle 6), all off by default. `configurableTypes` opens the type
catalogue (adopt, copy, edit, publish; P1) and lets the tenant's copies resolve; `customTypes` also allows types
of the tenant's own; the others belong to later phases and change nothing yet.

TenantIdentity.description: The read-only identity of the current tenant; platform staff change it through `/tenants/{id}`.

TenantSettingsDto.description:
Review policy, retention and the feature switches (docs/02 §1 "settings", docs/11 §18 "Settings"); the body of PUT
and the `settings` part of GET. TenantFeaturesDto? TenantSettingsDto.Features is optional on PUT: left out, the switches stay as they are.

ValueCandidateDto.description: A reading of the selected text as a field kind (docs/11 §12.3: "28.10.2026 → 2026-10-28"), in the shape a correction takes.

Bearer.description: OIDC access token from the configured authority (locally: Keycloak realm 'docproc').

ApiKey.description: Tenant API key (dpk_…) for machine clients; scopes ingest and/or read.
ApiKey.name: X-Api-Key
